NODE_MODULES FINDING (settled, do not re-litigate): alephbeis clones node_modules because grumphp.yml sets `bin: node_modules/.bin/eslint`, a LITERAL RELATIVE PATH resolved against cwd. It is NOT a Node module-resolution problem -- worktrees live inside the checkout and Node walks up, so the checkout's tree is already reachable. The source fixed the cause with scripts/quality/node-bin.sh (walks up, STOPS AT THE CHECKOUT so a stray ~/node_modules cannot supply the binary that decides whether the tree passes; tells checkout from worktree by .git being a dir vs a file). So the source's rule is right AND alephbeis's stated reason was wrong. AB-2427 ports the resolver and drops the clone.
KEPT AS ALEPHBEIS-BETTER (do not regress, do not port over): alephbeis's rm branch-deletion guards -- the task-branch marker, five refusals, `git branch -d` never -D, and the 7-case CI suite -- are stronger than the source's and were paid for by a real incident (a cleanup run deleted local develop). AB-2424 adds reclamation AROUND them.
